name: Arm eval regression harness
problem: Catch control-policy regressions with repeatable MuJoCo arm scenarios.
limits: An original open single-joint arm task is included as XML; no downloaded robot assets. Fixed seeds and simulator version reproduce scores locally. Cross-platform floating-point bit identity is not guaranteed. The gate requires success rate >=0.9. Recorded failing baseline is evidence/gate-failure.log. The deliberately failing PR is https://github.com/rjrddy/startup-projects/pull/1; its arm-policy-gate failed in run 39375033765. The demo branch must not be merged.
next: Add multi-joint contact tasks and cross-platform tolerance analysis.
